name: transolver_attention_fusion
description: Transolver backbone with ITERATED cross-fidelity attention as the multi-fidelity fusion mechanism. Different from v9_baseline (which uses a single gated MLP over multiple LF streams) and transolver_residual (hard residual on top of LF interp): here HF queries attend through N stacked cross-attention blocks, each refining the HF representation against the LF context. This stress-tests the 'attention IS the fusion' hypothesis without an explicit residual or gate.
